public_rationale: The reported 76% is plainly a wide majority, and the survey covered multiple research settings and regions. This supports Marcus's contextual point that skepticism about reaching AGI by scaling current approaches was widespread. It does not establish that respondents rejected every possible future LLM-based system, or that 76% of all AI researchers held this view.
limitations: The favorable assessment depends on reading the claim in its discussion of current approaches and scaling.
The survey measured doubts about success, not agreement that success was impossible.
The original report was checked, but its interleaved text extraction prevented a clean quotation of the result. The evidence item therefore quotes contemporaneous news reporting.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: A recent AAAI survey showed that doubting LLMs can reach AGI is the majority opinion, by a wide margin, among a broad sampling of researchers and academic scientists.
conditions: among a broad sampling of researchers and academic scientists

statement.excerpt: A recent AAAI survey showed that this is in fact the majority opinion among a broad sampling of researchers and academic scientists, by a wide margin.
statement.document_title: The False Glorification of Yann LeCun

from_speaker: a broad sampling of researchers and academic scientists
our_interpretation: The referenced observation is the 2025 AAAI Presidential Panel survey result available before the post.
In the surrounding discussion of scaling, doubting LLMs can reach AGI means doubting that scaling current approaches is sufficient.
A wide majority means substantially more than half, without imposing an arbitrary numerical cutoff.
Broad sampling means respondents across affiliations and regions. It does not imply a statistically representative sample of all AI researchers.
criteria.support_condition: The survey reports a clearly substantial majority doubting that scaling current AI approaches will yield AGI, with respondents drawn from multiple research settings and regions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The survey reports no majority, only a narrow majority, or a materially different proposition or respondent population.
